scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api litestar --app kernelon_api.asgi:app run --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api lint-imports --config apps/api/pyproject.toml
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --project apps/api litestar --app kernelon_api.asgi:app database upgrade --no-prompt
scripts.db:make-migration: uv run --project apps/api litestar --app kernelon_api.asgi:app database make-migrations
scripts.check: pnpm mineradio:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
